meta.title: NoNote — Your files were meant to become more
meta.description: NoNote is a local-first AI workspace that makes the files you already keep searchable, understandable, discussable and useful again.

hero.title: Your files were meant
hero.body: NoNote starts with what you already have, turning local files, notes and research into knowledge you can search, understand, discuss and build on.
hero.note: Free and open source · macOS & Windows

proof: Original files stay in your control

problem.lead: We do not need another place to save things.
problem.title: The hard part is making saved material useful again.
problem.body: Files accumulate while their value goes quiet. You remember reading something but not where. You know the material exists but cannot reconnect the scattered clues.

items.title: You can find the file, not the answer
items.text: Folders remember where something is, not why you kept it or what it connects to.

items.title: Every project starts with rereading
items.text: PDFs, Word files, Markdown and notes live in separate contexts, so understanding rarely compounds.

items.title: Useful answers stay trapped in chat
items.text: When the conversation ends, the result rarely returns to your file system as something you can evolve.

workflow.title: Keep your files. Change what they can do.
workflow.body: No migration ritual. NoNote builds understanding around your existing files so finding, asking and making become one piece of work.
workflow.mediaPending: One real Workspace continuing through the workflow

steps.title: Start with what you already keep
steps.text: Bring in an ordinary folder without giving up its familiar structure or original files.

steps.title: Search beyond filenames
steps.text: Read Markdown, TXT, PDF and DOCX together, combining exact words with semantic relevance.

steps.title: Follow every answer back to evidence
steps.text: Attach specific files or ask across a Workspace. Citations keep the answer connected to its source.

steps.title: Turn the result back into your file
steps.text: Preview what matters, choose a location and save it as an editable Markdown note.

why.title: We have already saved enough. What is missing is understanding.
why.body: Most knowledge tools begin with a blank page and ask you to reorganize, migrate and build a new habit. NoNote takes a different route: respect the file system you already have and begin with the work behind you.
why.quote: Do not rebuild your knowledge system. Let what you already have take part in the work you are doing now.

local.title: Your files stay local. Your choices stay yours.
local.body: Original material stays in the data location you choose. Metadata and indexes are stored locally. You can connect a local model or a remote provider; with a remote provider, relevant request content may be sent to that service.

points.title: Files remain ordinary files
points.text: Your source material stays directly accessible outside NoNote.

points.title: You choose the model
points.text: Connect local models such as Ollama or configure a remote OpenAI-compatible service.

points.title: The boundaries are inspectable
points.text: Data location, task state, public source and releases all have a verifiable path.

evidence.title: Not a concept mockup. The NoNote that already exists.
evidence.body: Every scene below comes from the current MVP: reading and understanding source material, receiving grounded answers, and observing durable local work.

items.label: Read
items.title: Understand different files in one workspace
items.text: Read the source, summary and tags, then step into a more focused reading surface when you need it.

items.label: Ask
items.title: Every answer remains connected to its source
items.text: Bring specific files into a conversation and inspect the citations instead of trusting an isolated block of text.

items.label: Background
items.title: Long-running work stays visible without blocking the interface
items.text: Imports, syncs and other durable tasks keep reporting progress, results and states that need attention in the Task Center.

download.title: Put your knowledge back to work.
download.body: Choose the installer that fits your device. We highlight a likely match, never start a download automatically and never hide the other available choices.
download.unsigned: Current builds are unsigned community test releases
download.unknown: We could not reliably detect your platform. Choose below.
download.macUnknown: We cannot detect your Mac chip. Check About This Mac, then choose Apple Silicon or Intel.

items.a: Original files stay local. If you configure a remote AI provider, relevant content needed for a request may be sent to that provider. You can instead connect a compatible local model.
The current release understands Markdown, TXT, PDF and DOCX. Original files are preserved; NoNote does not edit Word documents.

items.q: Can I use a local model?
items.a: Yes. NoNote can connect to compatible local providers such as Ollama. Model availability and performance depend on your hardware.

items.q: Is NoNote free and open source?
items.a: Yes. The source is available on GitHub under the MIT license.
Current releases include macOS for Apple Silicon and Intel, plus Windows x64. Linux packaging is not included yet.

items.q: How do I report an issue?
items.a: Open an issue in the GitHub repository and include your NoNote version, operating system and steps to reproduce.
